evidence: src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp, src/rpc/txoutproof.cpp, src/rpc/util.cpp, and src/rest.cpp are modified to return structured error information for pruned transactions.
rationale: RPC methods getrawtransaction and gettxoutproof, along with the REST /tx endpoint, gain structured error reporting containing pruned block hashes. This fills an interface gap, allowing client applications to fetch missing blocks on demand via getblockfrompeer.
